metadata.description: Official Docker plugins for Claude Code

plugins.name: mcp-toolkit
plugins.description: Integrates Docker Desktop's MCP Toolkit with Claude Code, enabling access to containerized MCP servers. Requires Docker Desktop 4.28+ with MCP Toolkit enabled.

plugins.name: flisk
plugins.description: Starts the local stack from service.json so the agent does not rewrite Dockerfiles. Skills and an MCP server for building, starting, checking and fixing a Docker-based local dev stack with the Flisk CLI. Requires: npm install -g @flisk-sh/flisk
